primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でヘブロンの子らの一人として名が挙がる。
primaryTextRead.text: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 次節はシェマがラハムの父になったと記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Shema became the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem became the father of Shammai.
